messages:
deploy-bot: Starting canary deploy of prompt-edge v3 -> staging2. deploy id deploy-5312348765. target 5% traffic. :rocket:
ava: noticing a spike in 5xx from prompt-edge canary, dashboard shows increased tail latency and OOM traces. sample log:
```
2026-03-17T17:12:03Z prompt-edge v3 kernel error: failed to select optimized kernel for seq_len=8192
Traceback: RuntimeError: incompatible kernel selection
```
ava: @maria can you take a look? and paging oncall if needed
incident-bot: paging oncall @maria (severity S3) — 5xx surge on prompt-edge canary. Escalation: SRE -> oncall. Incident channel: #incidents. Notify: cs-lead.
maria: I’m on it. please hold traffic to canary and prepare to flip feature flag if we confirm routing issues.
tyler: can we hit the admin toggle? ff key: `prompt_edge.experimental`
ava: confirmed errors across several shards. reproducer: short prompt with long context triggers kernel path that fails.
tyler: toggling ff `prompt_edge.experimental` -> OFF now via admin console.
(tyler toggled: `prompt_edge.experimental=false`) :white_check_mark:
deploy-bot: Canary aborted, traffic routed back to stable prompt-edge v2. Rolling back canary instances and draining pods. :no_entry_sign:
cs-lead: CS note: tenant "acme-inc" reported 10% error rate increase and some timeouts, we've opened a support ticket and messaged customer.
maria: good. collecting logs for a postmortem and creating incident tracker. Handing monitoring to next oncall @sam for 30m watch.
sam: ack, I'll monitor metrics and alerts for 30m, ping me if errors reappear.
ava: initial RCA: kernel selection for long-context requests in quantized binary didn't match runtime capability after the v3 compile. Needs a guarded fallback in kernel selector.
tyler: filing followup INF ticket: INF-2412 "prompt-edge v3 kernel-selection fallback + preflight". Assigned to runtime team.
maria: add action items: 1) retract canary (done), 2) block v3 rollout until preflight added, 3) add canary throttling and early kill conditions, 4) notify affected customers and CS (done).
maria: incident closed as S3 — feature-flag kill engaged, stability restored. handing full writeup to ENG-RELEASE and runtime teams. :closed_book: 
sam: watching 10 more minutes, all clear so far. :thumbsup:
ava: will re-run compile with compatibility flags and coordinate a safer roll-forward once INF-2412 lands.
(incident log saved to /var/log/incidents/5312348765-ff-kill-promptedge.log)
notes: feature flag kill-switch activated to stop canary traffic; on-call handoff; CS notified; follow-up ticket INF-2412 created
